title: Commerce: Product
description: A Product is an item in the company's inventory, and includes information about the price and quantity of all products, and variants thereof, available for sale.

name.description: Name of the product in the commerce or POS system

description.description: Description of the product recorded in the commerce or point of sale platform.
examples: 1 hour of support from an agent (phone or remote)

categorization.description: Retail category that the product is assigned to e.g. `Hardware`.

isGiftCard.description:
Whether the product represents a gift card or voucher that
can be redeemed in the commerce or POS platform.

productRef.description: Reference that links the line item to the correct product details.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product being referenced.

name.description: Name of the product being referenced.

productVariant.title: Product Variant
productVariant.description: Represents a variation of a product available for sale, for example an item of clothing that may be available for sale in multiple sizes and colors.

allOf.description: Identifier of the product variant, unique to the company.

name.description: Name of the product recorded in the commerce or point of sale platform.

isTaxEnabled.description: Whether sales taxes are enabled for this product variant.

sku.description: SKU (stock keeping unit) of the variant, as defined by the merchant.

barcode.description: Unique product number of the variant. This might be a barcode, UPC, ISBN, etc.

unitOfMeasure.description: Unit of measure for the variant, such as `kg` or `meters`.

vatPercentage.description: VAT rate for the product variant if sales taxes are enabled.

prices.description: Prices for the product variants in different currencies.

shippingRequired.description: Indicates whether or not the product requires physical delivery.

productVariantRef.title: Product variant reference
productVariantRef.description: Reference that links the line item to the specific version of product that has been ordered.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product variant being referenced.

name.description: Name of the product variant being referenced.

productInventory.title: Product Inventory
productInventory.description: Information about the total inventory as well as the locations inventory is in.

totalQuantity.description: The total quantity of stock remaining across locations.

quantity.description: The quantity of stock remaining at location.

productVariantStatus.description: The status of the product variant.
